stories.title: Trump administration to introduce new tariffs on China, EU and other major trading partners
stories.summary: The U.S. will increase tariffs on Chinese goods by an additional 20% and raise import taxes on goods from other major economies.

stories.title: Iran War Updates: Tehran denounces U.S. for using AI in strikes it claims violate international law
stories.summary: Iran's U.N. envoy claims the U.S. military used Palantir and Anthropic AI systems to select some 2,000 targets over just four days.

stories.title: Busy day at the airports; Martha Firestone Ford has died; other top stories
stories.summary: Nearly 2.9 million people are expected to travel by air on Wednesday, TSA says. Longtime Detroit Lions owner Martha Firestone Ford has died. Those headlines and other top stories are in the CBS Detroit news brief.

stories.title: Army to detonate unstable lead explosives at Iowa munitions plant
stories.summary: The U.S. Army is set to detonate a stockpile of degrading explosives at a munitions plant in Iowa on Wednesday morning, following community outcry and a legal fight that delayed the operation by several days.

stories.title: Fatal plane crash in Mississippi
stories.summary: Six people, including two children, have been found dead after a plane crashed off the coast of Mississippi on Tuesday, according to the U.S. Coast Guard.

stories.title: Thanksgiving holiday travel rush begins
stories.summary: CBS News takes a look at weather conditions across the country and heavy traffic forecasts for the day before Thanksgiving Day travel.

stories.title: Fire burning on Outer Drive in Detroit
stories.summary: Emergency crews were on scene early Wednesday at a building fire along Outer Drive in Detroit. Here's a look at the chopper view at about 6:30 a.m.

stories.title: 1 person struck by gunfire during shooting on I-96 in Detroit, MSP says
stories.summary: One person was struck and injured by gunfire Tuesday night after a freeway shooting along Interstate 96 in Detroit.

stories.title: Freeway shooting investigation
stories.summary: Michigan State Police are investigating a freeway shooting that injured one person along I-96 in Detroit.

stories.title: Rain showers expected in Southeast Michigan amid Thanksgiving travel
stories.summary: The Thanksgiving holiday week is here, and travel, at least on the weather front, has some minor bumps to get through.

stories.title: Rain moves in for Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Happy Hump Day Family! Getting closer to the big holiday. Looking at a dry, cool day with partly cloudy skies, high 44°. Thanksgiving Day, rain moves in by the afternoon, high 44°. Possible rain/snow mix Thanksgiving night into Friday morning. Clearing for part of the weekend Sat

stories.title: Army to detonate unstable lead explosives at Iowa munitions plant despite community concerns
stories.summary: The U.S. Army will detonate a stockpile of degrading explosives at a munitions plant in Iowa on Wednesday, after days of back-and-forth between politicians and the courts.
